spans.s:
--a R. from the ऋक्ष hill in भारतवर्ष, visited by बलराम;
1: भा. V. १९. १८; X. ७९. ११; Br. II. १६. २९.
sacred to पितृस्.
2: M. २२. ३५.
--in the Cyavana आश्रम of गया. वा. १०८. ७४.
--a son of राजाधिदेव; had five sons, all heroic warriors. M. ४४. ७८-9.

--built by Maya at the command of भण्ड; a city of बाण; visit of जरासन्ध to: Aniruddha taken to; besieged by the वृष्णिस् when बाण had imprisoned Anirud- dha, and नारद reported it to them. बाण's army beaten back into the city. Br. IV. १२. 4; भा. X. [5. (v) 1], [२१ & ६५]; ६२. 4 and २३; ६
